span.p:
【衍生】对账差异金额: recon_diff_amount: invoice_amount - COALESCE(reconciled_amount, 0)
【衍生】对账差异率: recon_diff_rate: COALESCE(recon_diff_amount / invoice_amount, 9999)
【触发】对账差异复核触发: recon_diff_amount ＞ 2000 且 recon_diff_rate ＞ 0.05
【触发】【新增】大额对账单提醒: invoice_amount ＞ 100000
